turns.reply: The bug is an overshoot in the initial position estimate: `text[:pos]` can already be wider than `cut` (e.g. when zero-width or combining characters follow a wide character), and the loop then mangles the split. I'll reset to the start when that happens.

turns.reply:
I fixed `Segment._split_cells` in `rich/segment.py` so that it resets its scan to the start when the initial position estimate already overshoots the cut. The existing segment tests pass (52), and a randomized check over text containing wide, zero-width and combining characters found no cases where the left piece exceeds the cut.

The cause: the starting index is estimated proportionally from character count, and with zero-width or combining characters after a wide character that estimate can land past the cut point. The scan then picked the wrong split. I did not add a regression test for this case.
